options_evaluated: Monomaterial Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) PC/ABS blend without overmolding
Post-consumer Recycled Polypropylene (rPP) with textured grip and mechanical fasteners
Aluminum alloy housing with mechanically fastened, replaceable rubber grip inserts
Virgin glass-filled polyamide (PA6-GF30) with overmolded TPE grip
decisions.conflict: Material and Design and Manufacture recommend post-consumer recycled polypropylene for low manufacturing energy, while In-Service rejects this due to its low impact resistance and instead recommends an aluminum alloy housing for maximum durability.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material durability and impact resistance vs end-of-life recyclability and low-carbon materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Monomaterial Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) PC/ABS blend without overmolding. PCR PC/ABS provides the necessary impact resistance and structural rigidity (engineering feasibility) to withstand drops without the high carbon footprint and weight of aluminum, while avoiding multi-material overmolding ensures high-quality end-of-life recyclability.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability and mechanical properties of commercial PCR PC/ABS grades to ensure they meet the minimum impact strength requirements for power tool housings.

options_evaluated: Integrated snap-fits without auxiliary fasteners
Reversible threaded fasteners directly into plastic bosses (single screw head type)
Reversible threaded fasteners with metal threaded inserts
Ultrasonic welding of housing halves
decisions.conflict: Manufacture recommends integrated snap-fits to eliminate auxiliary fasteners and simplify assembly, whereas In-Service and Circularity reject this because snap-fits are highly prone to breaking during disassembly, which severely hinders repairability.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing simplicity and speed vs ease of disassembly and repairability
decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible threaded fasteners with metal threaded inserts. While more complex to manufacture than snap-fits or direct plastic screws, metal inserts ensure the housing can be disassembled and reassembled multiple times for repair without stripping the threads, maximizing product lifespan.
decisions.design_action: Analyze the spatial layout and wall thickness requirements around the screw bosses to accommodate metal threaded inserts without increasing the external dimensions of the tool.

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with ferrite magnets and detachable copper windings
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with modular, non-glued neodymium magnets
Coreless DC motor with high-density copper coils
decisions.conflict: Material and Design and Manufacture recommend a brushed DC motor to avoid rare-earth magnets and complex electronics, whereas In-Service and Circularity reject this because brushed motors have a significantly shorter operational lifespan and lower energy efficiency.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: avoidance of critical raw materials vs operational energy efficiency and product durability
decisions.chief_resolution: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with modular, non-glued neodymium magnets. A brushless motor is essential for the tool's long-term durability and efficiency (engineering feasibility), and specifying modular, non-glued magnets allows for the recovery of critical rare-earth materials at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Identify suppliers of BLDC motors that offer modular, mechanically secured magnets rather than glued assemblies to facilitate end-of-life recovery.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via molded ventilation slots (open convection)
Passive thermal management via internal aluminum heatsinks coupled to a sealed housing
Active cooling fan with aluminum heatsink and open ventilation
Thermal potting compound/encapsulation of electronics
decisions.conflict: Material and Design and Manufacture recommend passive cooling via open ventilation slots to minimize weight and part count, whereas In-Service rejects this because open slots allow dust and moisture ingress that causes premature motor and electronics failure.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: material minimization vs environmental protection and component durability
decisions.chief_resolution: Passive thermal management via internal aluminum heatsinks coupled to a sealed housing. Since screwdrivers are frequently used in dusty environments, a sealed housing is critical for reliability (engineering feasibility), and using a mechanically attached internal heatsink avoids the unrecyclable nature of thermal potting compounds.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the thermal dissipation requirements of the selected BLDC motor under continuous load to determine the minimum surface area required for the internal heatsink.

options_evaluated: Monolithic integrated design with soldered connections
Partially modular design with soldered wire connections
Fully modular architecture with plug-and-play connectorized sub-assemblies
Fully modular, toolless slide-in swappable sub-assemblies
decisions.conflict: Manufacture recommends a monolithic integrated design to simplify the assembly line and reduce production waste, whereas In-Service and Circularity reject this because it makes individual component replacement impossible, forcing the entire tool to be discarded upon a single component failure.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: manufacturing assembly simplicity vs ease of repair and end-of-life material separation
decisions.chief_resolution: Fully modular architecture with plug-and-play connectorized sub-assemblies. This architecture balances assembly feasibility with sustainability by allowing easy replacement of high-wear components (like the trigger switch) and facilitating clean material separation at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability of standardized, vibration-resistant plug-and-play connectors that can fit within the internal volume of the screwdriver handle.

options_evaluated: Integrated (non-removable) lithium-ion pouch cell battery pack
Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with screw-fastened casing (cobalt-free chemistry)
Corded AC power supply (no battery)
decisions.conflict: Manufacture recommends corded AC power to eliminate the high environmental impact of battery manufacturing, whereas In-Service and Circularity reject this because a corded design lacks portability, which is the primary value proposition for the user.
espr_constraint: Lifecycle principle: elimination of battery environmental impacts vs product portability and battery circularity
decisions.chief_resolution: Removable and standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with screw-fastened casing (cobalt-free chemistry). Cordless operation is essential for market viability (engineering feasibility), and using a removable, standardized pack with cobalt-free chemistry (such as LFP) minimizes environmental impact while enabling battery replacement and circularity.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the market availability of standardized, cobalt-free (LFP) cylindrical cells that meet the discharge rate requirements for power tool applications.
